dct_description_sm: BC Transit routes for Victoria, Whistler, Pemberton Local and Commuter, Squamish Commuter, Kelowna and Kamloops. The routes were created from the Google transit feed (GTFS) and ArcGIS Network Analyst. As no route shape information was available from the feed, the shape of the route was extrapolated from the road network and layout of transit stops. The transit routes were not verified as no maps are available. Although routes were calculated as carefully as possible, this data set carries no guarantee of accuracy beyond the information included in the Google transit feed.
